column1: # "host" cells run on rootfs /; "alpine" cells need --rootfs alpine=DIR,
# laid out by bench/mktree.sh, with the bench binaries copied to DIR/bench-bin.
# --bin-host must hold the host-built binaries and stat-list.txt (see README).
# The build workload (lua) is in workloads-build.tsv.
# startup-min and startup-min-alpine do almost nothing: they measure the
# timer, timeout and runner startup that every other cell's wall time includes.

column6: sh -c 'i=0; while [ $i -lt 20000 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; echo $i'
sh -c 'i=0; while [ $i -lt 500 ]; do {BIN}/tick {RUNDIR}/count || exit 9; i=$((i+1)); done; echo children=$(($(wc -c < {RUNDIR}/count)))'
sh -c 't=0; n=0; while IFS= read -r f; do t=$((t+1)); [ -e "$f" ] && n=$((n+1)); done < {BIN}/stat-list.txt; [ "$t" -gt 0 ] && [ "$n" -eq "$t" ] && echo all-hit t=$t'
python3 -I -c 'import json, re, ssl, sqlite3, decimal, asyncio, email.parser; print("py-ok")'
